scenario: AITA for going to a non-refundable couples massage with my GF instead of helping my sister move? | A few weeks ago, my 28 year old sister mentioned that she would be moving to a different apartment on March 30, just down the hall from her current one. She asked my her BF, our Dad, Me, and another friend to help her move her furniture. I just noticed today that the time she chose to move conflicts with a non-refundable couples massage I booked for my GF and I back in January.
